fragments.reference_en: in beginning was the word and the word was with the God
and God was the word
he was in beginning with the God
all things through him came into being and without him came into being not even one thing that has come into being
in him life was and the life was the light the of men
and the light in the darkness shines and the darkness it not grasped
there came a man sent from God name to him John
he came as a witness that he may testify concerning the light that all may believe through him
not was he the light but that he may witness concerning the light
was the light the true who enlightens every man coming into the world
in the world he was and the world through him came into being and the world him not knew
to the his own he came and the his own him not received
as many as however received him he gave to them authority children of God to be to those believing in the name of him
who not of blood nor of will of flesh nor of will of man but of God were born
and the word flesh became and he dwelt among us and we beheld the glory of him
a glory as of an only begotten from Father full of grace and truth
John witnesses concerning him and he has cried out saying
this was he of whom i was saying the one after me coming precedence over me has because before me he was
for from the fullness of him we ourselves all have received then grace for grace
for the law through Moses was given the grace and the truth through Jesus Christ came
God no one has seen ever yet the only begotten God who is being in the bosom of the Father he has made known
